headline: AI Boom Ignites: Top 5 Banks' New Capital Expenditure Loans in August Hit Over 4.5-Year High | Industry
summary: Top five Taiwanese banks approved NT$121.826 billion in new capital expenditure loans in August, the highest in more than four and a half years, per central bank data.
why: Banks' corporate lending trends signal how businesses are investing, and AI-related capital spending is a key driver in Taiwan's economy.
